details.purpose: To record summary information about the pattern of use of tobacco and tobacco-containing products.
details.use: Use to record summary information about the pattern of use of tobacco and tobacco-containing products.
details.misuse: Not to be used to record event-or period-based information about tobacco use or consumption, such as actual daily use or the average use over a specified period of time - use the OBSERVATION.tobacco_use archetype.

items.items: Summary or persisting information about tobacco use or consumption.
Statement about the individual's current tobacco use.
Individual is a current user of tobacco.
Individual is a former or ex-user of tobacco.
Can be a partial date, for example, only a year.
Can be a partial date, for example, only a year. May also be known as the 'Quit Date'.
Estimate of the cumulative amount of cigarettes smoked, measured in pack years.

Commonly used in assessment of cigarette use. It is calculated by multiplying the number of packs of cigarettes smoked per day by the number of years the individual has smoked. One pack year equals 365 packs of cigarettes.
Additional narrative about the toacco use not captured in other fields.
For example: stopped smoking or reduced amount on becoming pregnant.
The date this tobacco use summary was last updated.
Estimate of typical use of the specified form of smoked tobacco per day - as a whole number or a range of cigarettes per day.
Number of times the individual has attempted to stop smoking the specified form of tobacco.
Details about each attempt to cease smoking.
Individual has ceased using tobacco within a defined time period.
Identification of the form of tobacco smoked.
Details about the pattern of smoking tobacco.
This cluster is explicitly modeled in the archetype because smoking is the single ubiquitous mode of tobacco use. All other modes should be detailed in CLUSTER archetypes specific to each type.
The typical pattern of use of the form of smoked tobacco.
The typical pattern of use can be coded with a terminology or a local value set in a template.
Narrative description of the individual's overall tobacco use.
The date when the individual first started using tobacco.
The date when the individual last ceased using tobacco.
Statement about the individual's current tobacco smoking.
Individual is a former or ex-smoker of tobacco.
Individual has ceased smoking tobacco within a defined time period.
Individual is a current smoker of tobacco.
Details about the pattern of smoking a specified form of tobacco.
Statement about the individual's current smoking of the specified form of smoking tobacco.
Narrative description of the individual's smoking of tobacco of the specified form.
Manufactured cigarettes, containing processed tobacco and rolled into a cylinder.
Hand-filled cigarettes using loose tobacco rolled in a cigarette paper.
Air-cured and fermented tobaccos with a tobacco-leaf wrapper.
Tobacco placed in a bowl and smoke inhaled through a stem.
Individual has never smoked tobacco of the specified form.
Individual is a former or ex-smoker of tobacco of the specified form.
Individual has ceased smoking tobacco of the specified form within a defined time period.
Individual is a current smoker of tobacco of the specified form.
Tobacco, often flavoured, is burned then cooled through a basin of water eand consumed through a hose and mouthpiece.
Estimate of typical use of the specified form of smoked tobacco per day.

Cardinality is set to 1..1 to allow only one of the two elements to be present at any time. Please note: The period of time to which this data element is not specified. If exact consumption at specific points in time or averages/maximums over specified intervals of time are required, use the OBSERVATION.tobacco_use archetype.
Estimate of typical use of the specified form of smoked tobacco per day - as a number of grams per day.
Identified triggers which stimulate or cause smoking of this form of tobacco.
The context in which the individual uses tobacco.
Details regarding the individual's smoking of the specified form of tobacco.
Additional narrative about smoking of the specified form of tobacco, not captured in other fields.
Details about the use of other, non-smoked forms of tobacco.
The definition of the time period used in the Status value "Quitting".
The definition of the size of pack or tin used in the Pack years/Tin years elements in this archetype and in clusters.
